cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get your dad's visit from tomorrow ready. Put his chair by the machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says he can't arrive. I only wanted five minutes with him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: His voice came through. We'll start with that; bring the chair closer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered the line that says 'audio only.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the chair to the speaker. Write your first question; I'll try to get him back on.
